items.title: Love watching something you helped build keep growing without you.
items.content:
Love watching something you helped build keep growing without you.Casey (@casey_lau)Huge  @Pokemon show in SF Bay Area today — part of Ari Emanuel’s MARI empire. 

MARI acquired  @Collect_A_Con in April 2026 cementing it as the nation's premier card expo:
• 27+ shows/year nationwide 
• 500K+ total annual attendees
• 600+ vendors & 900+ tables per event

Mari also owns tennis, art and culture festivals and theatrical venues. 

I attended because of a great interview  @ChrisCamillo did with  @myfirstmilpod 
Video
  —  https://x.com/casey_lau/status/2098927373043499124 
— Chris Camillo (@ChrisCamillo) Sep 13, 2026
